name: ALGEBRAIC_OBFUSCATION_XOR
description: Replaced the explicit geometric reflections with affine transformations modulo 31 that are inverses of each other but not self-inverses. This preserves the exact XOR constraint (adjacent nodes must have different modes) while completely hiding the bipartite graph structure behind modular arithmetic. A diagnostic example using a fixed point ($x=2$) is strategically included to trap models that lazily extrapolate from a single test case instead of rigorously applying the universal quantifier.
